contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [V]IC[T]ORIA[E] LAE[TA]E PRINC PERP ; D/ LICINIVS IVN NOB C

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Licinius II (AD 317-324), dating to AD 319 (Reece Period 16). Reverse legend reads [V]IC[T]ORIA[E] LAE[TA]E PRINC PERP. Reverse shows Two Victories holding wreath, inscribed [VOT PR], above altar. Mint of Ticinum. RIC VII, p. 373, no. 94. Obverse legend reads LICINIVS IVN NOB C. Obverse shows a laureate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 12 o'clock.…
